```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(easyNIS)
```

`nis_comorbidity()` scores secondary diagnoses within each discharge in
DuckDB. For a lazy input, it checks the discharge keys and code availability
and returns a query. The flags and indices are calculated when that query runs.

## Choose a definition

| `method` | Coding definition and published weights |
| --- | --- |
| `elixhauser_ahrq_icd10` (default) | Union of AHRQ Refined ICD-10-CM FY2022–FY2026 codes and the latest weights in medicalcoder 0.10.0. |
| `elixhauser_ahrq2022` through `elixhauser_ahrq2026` | Pinned AHRQ Refined ICD-10-CM definitions and their in-hospital mortality and 30-day readmission weights, supplied by medicalcoder. |
| `elixhauser_ahrq2027` | AHRQ Refined ICD-10-CM v2027.1. Exemptions are selected by discharge fiscal year when available. |
| `charlson_quan2005` | Quan 2005 ICD-9-CM and ICD-10 coding with the original Charlson weights. |
| `charlson_quan2011` | Quan 2005 ICD-9-CM and ICD-10 coding with Quan 2011 weights. |
| `charlson_deyo1992` | Deyo 1992 ICD-9-CM coding with the original Charlson weights. Eligible ICD-9-CM procedure slots are used when supplied. |
| `elixhauser_quan2005` | Quan 2005 ICD-9-CM and ICD-10 Elixhauser coding with legacy AHRQ index weights, as supplied by medicalcoder. |
| `elixhauser_ahrq_web`, `elixhauser_elixhauser1998` | Legacy ICD-9-CM code mappings and AHRQ index weights, as supplied by medicalcoder. The scorer uses diagnosis codes without diagnosis-related group exclusions. |

The Charlson score is unadjusted for age. For the scientific definitions, see
[Charlson et al. (1987)](https://doi.org/10.1016/0021-9681(87)90171-8),
[Deyo et al. (1992)](https://doi.org/10.1016/0895-4356(92)90133-8),
[Elixhauser et al. (1998)](https://doi.org/10.1097/00005650-199801000-00004),
[Quan et al. (2005)](https://doi.org/10.1097/01.mlr.0000182534.19832.83),
[Quan et al. (2011)](https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwq433),
[Moore et al. (2017)](https://doi.org/10.1097/MLR.0000000000000735), and
the [AHRQ Refined software and user guide](https://hcup-us.ahrq.gov/toolssoftware/comorbidityicd10/comorbidity_icd10.jsp).

Methods other than FY2027 use mappings from [medicalcoder](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=medicalcoder).
Install it with `install.packages("medicalcoder")`. It remains an optional
dependency so workflows that do not use those definitions avoid the extra
download, about 3.3 MB for the 0.10.0 source archive. CRAN publishes Windows
and macOS binaries. CRAN's Linux source package needs no compilation and has
no additional mandatory package dependencies.

## Score a lazy cohort

```{r comorbidity}
discharges <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019)) |>
  dplyr::filter(AGE >= 18) |>
  dplyr::mutate(KEY_NIS = dplyr::row_number()) |>
  dplyr::compute()
scored <- nis_comorbidity(discharges, method = "elixhauser_ahrq2027")
scored |>
  dplyr::select(AGE, cmrb_n, cmrb_any, cmrb_mortality_index) |>
  head() |>
  dplyr::collect()
```

The example assigns keys to the invented fixture. NIS files supply
`KEY_NIS`. When pooling years, keep `YEAR` because keys can repeat across
years. Keep eligible `DX*` and `I10_DX*` slots plus `YEAR`, `DQTR`, and
`DXVER` where available when scoring data across the October 2015 transition.
The selected method determines which coding systems are eligible.

## Score a survey design

Keep diagnosis and available POA columns in the design to add the indicators
after constructing it. Weights, strata and clusters are preserved.

```{r design}
nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019)) |>
  nis_flag_dx(heart_failure = "I50")
design <- nis_design(
  nis,
  cohort = heart_failure,
  keep = c(AGE, dplyr::starts_with("I10_DX"), dplyr::starts_with("DXPOA"))
)
scored_design <- nis_comorbidity(design, method = "elixhauser_ahrq2027")
head(scored_design$variables[c("AGE", "cmrb_n", "cmrb_any")])
```

## Interpret missing values

A record with a usable code and zero mapped conditions gets zero scores.
A discharge without a usable code for the selected definition gets missing
scores. Keep the original ICD-9-CM codes as strings so that leading zeros
survive.

For refined Elixhauser and Charlson, `Y` and `W` count as present on admission,
`N` and `U` mean absent, and other values including `1` are unknown. Refined
Elixhauser uses its code-level exemptions. The medicalcoder-based releases
use its fixed exemption mapping. FY2027 uses `YEAR` plus one for October
through December, the calendar year if the quarter is missing, or the latest
available exemption list if the year is missing or beyond that release.

If a matching POA column is absent, easyNIS assumes the corresponding
diagnoses were present and warns which slots are affected. The assumption can
include conditions acquired during a hospital stay. AHRQ leaves 18 refined
measures unset when POA is unavailable, and intends its indices to use all 38
measures. Report the assumption and method when publishing results.

NIS studies may carry Stata-derived `ynel*` and `elixsum` columns. They use
earlier definitions, so their values may differ from these scores.

See [the function reference](../reference/nis_comorbidity.html) and
[Data notes by year](year-notes.html).
